note: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is [age-standardized](#dod:age_standardized).
title: Share of women with bipolar disorder
subtitle: Estimated share of women who have [bipolar disorder](#dod:bipolar_disorder), whether or not they are diagnosed, based on representative surveys, medical data, and statistical modeling. Prevalence is measured as the share experiencing bipolar disorder at a given point in time. It does not measure lifetime prevalence.
